MiniApp__Meta.MiniApp__Description: This data is used to build the cards for the mini apps launcher page, it is a useful page that links to all of my small utilities and tools that I have created, keeping them all in one place for easy access on the web from my main website rather than having numerous links to different tools and utilities on the main website

MiniApp__PageConfig.MiniApp__PageSubHeading: A collection of small utilities and tools by Noble Architecture

MiniApp__Schema__Template.MiniApp__RelativePath: The Relative Path To The Index File From the Base Url
MiniApp__Schema__Template.MiniApp__Description: The Description here for the Mini App
MiniApp__Schema__Template.MiniApp__Notes: Useful Dev Notes here for the Mini App, these notes are not displayed on the page but are useful for development.
MiniApp__Schema__Template.MiniApp__LoadOrder: Use 1, 2, 3, etc. for the order, This is used to sort the apps in the launcher page.

MiniApp__RoofPitchCalculator_01.MiniApp__Description: Calculate vertical and diagonal roof dimensions from a given bottom length and pitch angle. Draws an interactive triangle diagram with live updating measurements.
MiniApp__RoofPitchCalculator_01.MiniApp__Notes: Originally saved from a Pushbullet share. Single-file HTML app with inline CSS and JS, uses canvas for the triangle drawing.

MiniApp__ThermalCalcTool_02.MiniApp__Description: Calculate U-values for building components in compliance with ISO 6946:2017(E). Select materials from a comprehensive JSON database covering insulation, masonry, timber, and more.
MiniApp__ThermalCalcTool_02.MiniApp__Notes: Multi-file app with separate CSS, JS modules and JSON thermal data. References the NA Core Utility Stylesheet. Version 1.4.2.

MiniApp__ScaleAccuratePaperGen_03.MiniApp__Description: Generate scale-accurate paper templates for ISO A-series sheets (A0 through A5) with architectural scale factors from 1:1 to 1:1250. Export as PNG or PDF with optional dimension lines.
MiniApp__ScaleAccuratePaperGen_03.MiniApp__Notes: Single-file HTML app with inline CSS and JS. Uses canvas rendering for paper preview and jsPDF for PDF export.
